description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, replacement single storey side extension, replacement timber sash windows with double-glazed, double hung hardwood sash windows throughout and addition of new windows and doors on the west and east elevations, erection of a brick enclosure for a mobility lift on the rear & east elevation, the erection of metal safety railings on the roof, erection of glasshouse within rear garden, removal of concrete steps from the west elevation, replacement with new steps and addition of air cooled condenser within garden.
decision_conditions: Please can also they clarify if they are proposing a roof terrace? The plans show an area of flat roof with railings which looks to be a roof terrace. Please also clarify the certificate, the agent has submitted certificate B but I'm not sure if this should be certificate A as it would be the agent on behalf of the owner?
